title: Vielzahl an Straftaten bei Flucht vor Polizei

extraction.summaryEn: Plainclothes officers caught a 22-year-old loading construction material from a building site into a car in Britz; the group fled, crashing into parked cars, and the driver was arrested after a chase on foot. Investigators are pursuing charges including aggravated gang theft and attempted dangerous bodily injury.
